gaps: Division and regional land leaders (VP / Director of Land Acquisition, Land Development, Forward Planning): none confirmed. KB Home does not name them in press releases or filings, and per-market land searches were not run. Three HBA board listings give KB Home people without titles (Las Vegas, Tucson, Bay Area) and are recorded as affiliation-only leads.

Corporate land: Albert Z. Praw, EVP Real Estate and Business Development, gave notice on 16 November 2026 that he retires on 30 November 2026 and will advise on land relationships and transactions for up to a year (8-K filed 2026-11-16). Belongs in the corporate file; no successor named in the filing.

Regional structure: only four regional executives are named publicly (East Region; Northern California; Coastal Southern California; Las Vegas/Idaho). No regional president was found for Texas, Colorado, Arizona or Seattle. The last 'Central Regional President' named in a release was Larry Oglesby in December 2020 and is not carried here.
Who the regional presidents / regional general managers report to: not stated publicly (Robert McGibney ran operations as President and COO until he became CEO on 1 March 2026).
South Bay / Silicon Valley division president: none named since Kevin Kimball (last quoted May 2024). Regional General Manager Oren Hershkovich is quoted on South Bay communities in 2025 and 2026.
Fresno / Central California: no separate division president named; Fresno releases quote Oren Hershkovich and Madera releases quote Matt Sauls.
Boise: current division president uncertain (Stan Katanic last quoted October 2025; the April 2026 Idaho release quotes the regional general manager).
Charlotte and Raleigh: no 2026 confirmation of the division presidents (last company releases February and March 2025).

Dallas and Houston: both division presidents changed in 2026 without an appointment release; start dates and backgrounds of Ben Clark and Marc Tindall, and where Marcia Dillon and Brett Dietz went, were not found.
Phones and emails for division leaders: KB Home publishes only the general line 888-KB-HOMES.
Local business-journal, Builder / HousingWire and conference-speaker sources per market: not checked. They would most likely add land leaders and settle Boise, Charlotte and Raleigh.
